specs.Camera Lens: Fixed focus lens with no optical zoom capability, designed for simple point-and-shoot photography.

features: MINI KEYCHAIN DIGITAL CAMERA — A fun pocket digicam made for capturing everyday photos, quick videos, travel memories and spontaneous moments. The keychain-style design also makes it a playful camera accessory and bag charm.
20MP PHOTOS + 1080P HD VIDEO — Capture photos up to 20MP and record 1080P HD video with this micro thumb camera, ideal for casual photography, short vlogs, travel clips and everyday content.
BUILT-IN FLASH FOR LOW-LIGHT SHOTS — Keep capturing when the lights go down. The built-in flashlight provides extra illumination for night shots, indoor moments, parties and low-light photography.

RETRO DIGICAM, MODERN FUN — Vintage-inspired styling gives this mini digital camera a nostalgic Y2K digicam vibe while keeping photo and video recording simple with an easy point-and-shoot experience.

IPS SCREEN & EASY SHOOTING — Preview photos, videos and camera modes directly on the built-in IPS display. Fixed-focus operation keeps shooting quick and straightforward for beginners and everyday users.
MADE FOR EVERYDAY ADVENTURES — A mini vlog camera for students, teens and adults who love recording life on the go—perfect for travel, college, sports, cycling, hiking, outings and everyday memories.
description: Bring back the fun of compact digital photography with the LEQTRONIQ Mini Keychain Digital Camera. Designed as a tiny thumb camera, pocket digicam and HD video recorder, it makes capturing everyday photos and videos simple and fun. Shoot 20MP photos, record 1080P HD video, preview your content on the built-in IPS screen and quickly capture moments with an easy point-and-shoot design. Its miniature keychain-style look gives it a playful retro/Y2K digicam aesthetic, making it great for travel, college, parties, casual vlogging, selfies and everyday memories. Whether you're looking for a mini digital camera, keychain camera, pocket camera, vlog camera, retro digicam or bag charm camera, LEQTRONIQ gives you a fun way to shoot and carry your camera wherever the day takes you.
